subject: English
question_text: Use capitals and punctuation marks where necessary in the following text:
stimulus: whats your programme after the examination asked ratul nabil said i havent yet decided can you suggest any lets go on a picnic said ratul what an excellent idea Part B : Composition (40 Marks)
guide_solution: "What's your programme after the examination?" asked Ratul. Nabil said, "I havn't yet decided. Can you suggest any?" "Let's go on a picnic," said Ratul. "What an excellent idea!"
